add_executable(test_vlc test_vlc.c lifted_manual.c cpu_rt.c)
add_executable(test_vlc_auto test_vlc.c lifted_auto.c cpu_rt.c)   # same harness, generated lift
add_executable(recomp_decode recomp_decode.c lifted_codec.c cpu_rt.c)  # full lifted pipeline (110 fns)

# Standalone decoder: same lift + the DLL's data sections reconstructed from a
# generated blob, so NO DECO_32.DLL file is needed at runtime. deco32_data.c is
# regenerated by gen_deco_data.py from the user's own DLL and is gitignored.
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/deco32_data.c)
    add_executable(recomp_decode_standalone recomp_decode.c lifted_codec.c cpu_rt.c deco32_data.c)
    target_compile_definitions(recomp_decode_standalone PRIVATE DECO_STANDALONE)
endif()
add_executable(recomp_encapi recomp_encapi.c encapi_lifted.c cpu_rt.c)  # ENCAPI32 lift + Win32 import trampoline
add_executable(recomp_enc97 recomp_enc97.c enc97_one.c cpu_rt.c)  # execute a lifted ENC97.EXE function
add_executable(recomp_enc97_iat recomp_enc97_iat.c)  # wire + report ENC97's 914-import IAT

# Full 7,326-function ENC97 lift exercised at scale (40 MB generated source).
# enc97_full.c / enc97_full_list.h are regenerated by lift.py and NOT committed
# (too large); guarded so the target only exists when they're present locally.
if(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/enc97_full.c)
    add_executable(recomp_enc97_full recomp_enc97_full.c enc97_full.c cpu_rt.c)
    add_executable(recomp_enc97_run recomp_enc97_run.c enc97_full.c cpu_rt.c)  # boot the lifted main app
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_link_options(test_vlc PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
    target_link_options(test_vlc_auto PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
    target_link_options(recomp_decode PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
    # keep mapped image + emulated stack in the low 32-bit range (CPU regs are uint32_t)
    target_link_options(recomp_enc97 PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
    target_link_options(recomp_enc97_iat PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
    target_compile_options(recomp_decode PRIVATE /wd4244 /wd4146)  # generated-code narrowing/unary-minus
    if(TARGET recomp_decode_standalone)
        target_link_options(recomp_decode_standalone PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
        target_compile_options(recomp_decode_standalone PRIVATE /wd4244 /wd4146)
    endif()
    if(TARGET recomp_enc97_full)
        target_link_options(recomp_enc97_full PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO)
        # /Od: the MSVC optimizer chokes for many minutes on the 40 MB monolithic
        # TU; codegen level does not affect the lifted semantics, so disable it.
        target_compile_options(recomp_enc97_full PRIVATE /Od /bigobj /wd4244 /wd4146)
        # add LEAF_TRACE to print each leaf VA to stderr (debugging the sweep)
    endif()
    if(TARGET recomp_enc97_run)
        # host must NOT sit at 0x400000 so ENC97 can map at its preferred base
        # (delta=0; the lifter doesn't relocate address immediates).
        target_link_options(recomp_enc97_run PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE:NO /BASE:0x60000000 /DYNAMICBASE:NO /MAP)
        target_compile_options(recomp_enc97_run PRIVATE /Od /bigobj /wd4244 /wd4146)
        # The video bridge, if it has been built. The harness LoadLibrary's it
        # by name to register the recompiled Indeo codec, so it has to sit
        # beside the executable; built by tools/indeo/runtime/build.bat, which
        # generates forty segments of lifted C and is not a CMake target.
        set(IR32VFW ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/indeo/runtime/build/ir32vfw.dll)
        if(EXISTS ${IR32VFW})
            add_custom_command(TARGET recomp_enc97_run POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                        ${IR32VFW} $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:recomp_enc97_run>)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
target_include_directories(recomp_decode PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/decooracle)
if(TARGET recomp_decode_standalone)
    target_include_directories(recomp_decode_standalone PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/decooracle)
endif()
